## Body

BLOCK at 5c219c0b34c1f2e3e2253e68bbf96f8fca1a9631, round 1.

B320-01 — F268(b) still permits recovery of an already healthy receiver.
`update_native_receiver` renews the mechanical lease before the renewed audit
append. When that append fails, `outstanding()` still sees the old lapse and
`on_lapse()` has no current receiver-live brake
(`crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs:475-505`;
`crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery.rs:659-673,701-719`).
The real-SQLite witness
`review_f268_failed_renewal_must_not_restart_a_live_receiver_before_retry`
leaves the first lapse undecided, renews, loses one renewed append, and reconciles
before another heartbeat. `native_receiver_reason` is None, yet one `/restart`
control is queued. Retrying on the next heartbeat does not close this intervening
policy-input window. This is the outstanding F268(b) scope.

B320-02 — the new audit-retry mark can conceal a later real receiver loss.
The added reinsert uses the same `native_lapsed` membership that suppresses
fresh lapse publication (`crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs:499-505,831-839`).
After the first lapse is decided, a renewal succeeds mechanically but its audit
fails. If the extension dies before its next retry heartbeat, a second actual
lease expiry finds the retry mark already present and publishes no new lapse.
The first decision still suppresses recovery: there is no outstanding new loss
for either the live follower or its gap reconcile. The real-store witness
`review_second_expiry_after_failed_renewal` restores a forty-minute-old acting
decision into an empty ledger and makes the now-idle receiver expire again:
one lapse edge and zero restart controls, expected two edges and one control.
Removing only the added reinsert produces two edges and one control on the
same ordering. This is a demonstrated regression, not a request to remove
audit retry: its separate retry control fails when that reinsert is removed.

Answers to the other asks:
- (a) PASS: a gap during detached throttle sleep is covered by the next durable

  prompt. The lack of an inner stop select is not a shutdown hang here.
- F260 merge ordering PASS: the old held body returns once despite a failed

- (c) PASS for sequential state semantics: a held decision survives an
